t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes come in fixed color pairs. Certain colors lead to the bright forest, while the other color of the pair would lead to the dark forest. The number of mushrooms in the forests change constantly. The size of the gnome and the shape of their hats are irrelevant.

vb_textbox.text: There are 3 important features to be aware of in this game. You have to pay very close attention to these details to get the most points. First important feature is that the gnomes come in fixed pairs. These never change throughout the entire game. Red & YellowGreen & PinkOrange & BrownBlue and PurpleSecond important feature, one specific gnome of each pair leads to the light forest, while the other leads to the dark forest. The red, green, orange and blue gnomes always lead to the bright forest with a red basket, while the yellow, pink, brown and purple gnomes all lead to the dark forest with a yellow basket. This is crucial to know and keep track of. Third important feature is that one forest will have more mushrooms than the other and this changes constantly. However, there is a bit of consistency. For example, if you select a gnome that leads to the bright forest, and you get a high number of mushrooms, there is a high chance that if you select a bright forest gnome in the next round, you will also get a high number of mushrooms. This will stay fairly consistent for the next few rounds. But pay close attention to when the number of mushrooms drop. This is your sign to switch forests and start selecting dark forest gnomes instead. You would typically see that the dark forest will now have a high amount of mushrooms. The switch does happen randomly so, you need to pay attention.
